content.short: Kelp is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless liquid staking platforms within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: Kelp DAO is a liquid restaking protocol. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Kelp redefines how users interact with liquid staking platforms. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Ethereum to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Kelp stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
content.meta: Kelp provides innovative liquid staking platforms tools for the DeFi Dapps space. Discover Kelp and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
